{{Quote|The vault facility is built into a volcanic mesa, with a single entrance above the magma.|Katha Niar|<ref name="HC">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
The '''volcanic mesa''' was a [[mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] that was known for its significant magma chamber that was the site of [[Stronghold One]], a secure facility that contained the planet's treasury. The mesa contained an extensive cave system; the western caverns were known as the [[Scorching Grotto]], and the eastern caves were known as the [[Sweltering Caverns]]. A landing pad was established by Makeb's inhabitants on the northern side of the mesa, and the interior was home to a number of native [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;[[exoboar]]s, [[underwalker]]s, [[Geo Beast]]s and [[subteroth]]s preyed upon each other in the volcanic caves, attacking anything that trespassed in their territory. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces detonated explosives throughout the caves to simulate a [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] and damaged Stronghold One's security. The explosions also damaged the mesa itself, shearing off chunks from the upper portions of the mesa.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|Volcanic mesa|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>
